newsitem.title: TAJIKISTAN: Russian officer shot dead in Tajikistan.
newsitem.headline: Russian officer shot dead in Tajikistan.

text.p: An unidentified gunman killed an officer of the Russian peacekeeping force in the Tajik capital Dushanbe on Tuesday, Russian military sources said.
They quoted witnesses as saying that a young man, apparently an ethnic Tajik, shot Major Valery Torlin, 35, deputy commander of a tank regiment of Russia's 201 Motor Rifle division.

The gunman escaped. No-one claimed responsibility for the attack, yet another in a string of incidents blamed by the Russian military and the Tajik authorities on the Islamist opposition or on rogue groups of bandits.
Russian soldiers stationed in Tajikistan have often come under fire from the Islamist guerrillas, who have battled the former Soviet republic's secular government over the past four years.

The rebels, who are now in the process of peace talks with the Tajik government, have denied responsibility for earlier attacks and blamed them on an unspecified "third force" which seeks to disrupt the fragile peace process.
